Author: Zhyra
Name: Blackjack Advisor
Punchline: Optimal blackjack moves for FFXIV /random card games.
Description: Enter your hand and the dealer's up card and it tells you the mathematically best move (hit / stand / double / split), computed exactly for the in-game /random 1-13 (infinite-deck) variant. Configurable dealer rules (H17/S17), one-click buttons to say your move in chat (only when you press them, never automatic), and a live gil session tracker.
